description: Na₃LiWO₅ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.81 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent LiO₅ square pyramids, edges with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra, edges with four NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one LiO₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-14°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.59 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent LiO₅ square pyramids, edges with three equivalent WO₆ octahedra, edges with four NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent LiO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-18°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.41 Å. Li is bonded to five O atoms to form LiO₅ square pyramids that share corners with five NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent WO₆ octahedra, edges with four NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one LiO₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-79°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.21 Å. W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one WO₆ octahedra, edges with five NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent LiO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-18°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.15 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and one W atom to form distorted ONa₄W trigonal bipyramids that share corners with nine ONa₃LiW₂ octahedra, edges with six ONa₃LiW₂ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₄W trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-83°. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Li, and two equivalent W atoms to form distorted ONa₃LiW₂ octahedra that share corners with five ONa₃Li₂W octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₄W trigonal bipyramids, edges with ten ONa₃LiW₂ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₄W trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-13°. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na, two equivalent Li, and one W atom to form distorted ONa₃Li₂W octahedra that share corners with five ONa₃LiW₂ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₄W trigonal bipyramid, edges with ten ONa₃LiW₂ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₄W trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-17°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to four Na, one Li, and one W atom to form distorted ONa₄LiW octahedra that share corners with four ONa₃LiW₂ octahedra, corners with three equivalent ONa₄W trigonal bipyramids, edges with nine ONa₃LiW₂ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₄W trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-17°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four Na, one Li, and one W atom to form distorted ONa₄LiW octahedra that share corners with four ONa₃LiW₂ octahedra, corners with three equivalent ONa₄W trigonal bipyramids, edges with nine ONa₃LiW₂ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₄W trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-16°.
